tasks.title: Fix-forward (review 2026-10-01 #1/#2/#3): move the PAUSED indicator into render.ts/compactLine.ts per spec §8 placement
tasks.dod: renderFrame() appends PAUSED to the header line and renderCompactLine() prepends it to the line, both covered by unit tests; drawDashboard/drawCompact in timer.ts delegate to them so a resumed repaint can never leave stale PAUSED text, and the compact line never exceeds terminalWidth while paused.

tasks.title: Fix-forward (review 2026-10-01 #4/#7): make the resume-flush real-time-aware and re-arm the countdown interval across pause/resume
tasks.dod: Resuming only flushes the deferred transition immediately when at least one full second of real time actually elapsed while paused (tracked via Date.now()); a near-zero-duration pause/resume at secondsRemaining<=1 waits for the next tick like normal. The countdown interval is cleared on pause and re-armed fresh on resume so post-resume cadence isn't skewed by the interval's original phase.

tasks.title: Fix-forward (review 2026-10-01 #8): remove the production removeAllListeners workaround
tasks.dod: src/io/timer.ts no longer calls process.removeAllListeners for exit/SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP; every test describe block that calls startTimer() cleans up its own process listeners in afterEach instead, with no cross-test listener leakage.

tasks.title: Fix-forward (review 2026-10-01 #9): add missing AC-03/AC-06 exit-path and plain-mode test coverage
tasks.dod: Tests confirm: spacebar does nothing in plain mode (no keystroke capture wired); an unhandled exception still restores the terminal via the exit-event cleanup; the native (non-keypress) SIGINT handler restores the terminal and exits.
